hidden_first_page_evidence.xml: section2 first paragraph newNum PAGE=1 and pageHiding hidePageNum=1

verification_scope: Source syntax and explicitly authorized read-only base.hwpx/base.pdf heading/footer mapping; no HWPX writing or COM execution

implementation.pdf: Bottom-center text bbox y>86% page height; classify Arabic/Roman, locate unique chapter1 through observed footer or verified hidden restart, require every later observed Arabic footer contiguous; exact normalized whole-line windows up to 8 lines; main headings restricted to chapter bounds and ascending paragraph/PDF order
implementation.leader: Clone existing hh:tabPr and hh:paraPr; hh:tabItem type=RIGHT leader=DOT in existing case/default with native/fallback positions; hp:t contains hp:tab width=0 leader=1 type=2 then observed page number
implementation.long_titles: Preserve original charPr/height (94 main entries 12pt; 28 captions 11pt), insert hp:lineBreak at conservative full-cell widths reserving page-number width plus two cells, left indent by heading level, keepLines=1
implementation.preservation: Patch raw section1 top-level paragraph byte spans only; append cloned header definitions and update collection itemCnt only; copy all other ZIP member bytes and metadata, verify unchanged members on runtime output
implementation.normalization: NFKC, casefold, remove spacing/punctuation only; no fuzzy or guessed semantic aliases; no title wording differences requiring aliases found in base 122 entries; XML title text used to bridge PDF line wrapping

approved_md_note: Approved MD has shortened first-chapter structure; input after main intro transfer is enumerated dynamically, no base paragraph indices or old first-chapter titles hardcoded; existing extra appendix subdivisions and Abstract preserved
runtime_followup: Run four-argument CLI with matching introduction-applied and Hancom-reflowed HWPX/PDF; choose new output HWPX and JSON report paths
Hancom reopen/reflow and visual PDF review remain required: actual tab rendering, right alignment, long-title overlap and page-break quality are not tested in worker
If front-matter Roman entries exist and pagination shifts, rerun with re-exported PDF and another new output filename; body Arabic labels restart and should remain stable
